chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding a husband who died and left a wife, he (peace be upon him) said: 'For her is the quarter, and hand over the remainder to us (peace be upon us).'

key_terms.إِلَيْنَا: To us (referring to the Imam or authority)
key_terms.الرُّبُعُ: The quarter share (one-fourth) of the estate

ai.seo_question: What is the wife's share of inheritance if her husband dies without children or other relatives?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific inheritance share of a widow as one-quarter of the estate when her husband dies without leaving any other heirs, such as children or parents. The remainder is allocated to the Imam (or the ruling authority) as the sole heir, reflecting the Shia concept of the Imam's role in inheriting from those with no other living relatives. This ruling is derived from the general principle in Surah An-Nisa that the spouse receives a fixed portion, with the residue going to the 'Asabah' or the Imam in the absence of other heirs.
